title: Rahul Gandhi dharna: Police register FIR on protester's pellet injury complaint
content: Delhi Police registered an FIR regarding a student protester's alleged pellet-gun injury.  Rahul Gandhi staged a sit-in after alleging the complaint was initially refused.  The student, Sahil Lochab, claims over 200 pellets lodged in his body.  He stated his vision in one eye remains unclear after surgery.  The protest concerned alleged irregularities and the NEET paper-leak controversy.

title: Maharashtra teen jumps off cliff, parents fall to death trying to save him
content: A family of three tragically died after falling into a deep stone quarry on Friday. The incident occurred when parents attempted to save their son from a dangerous cliff edge. Police and fire brigade personnel were present and had been trying to persuade the youth for hours. The son suddenly fell, and his father tried to grab him, losing his own balance.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
content: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: 'Programme not appropriate': MEA on no clearance for Telangana CM's US visit
content: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's planned visit to the US has been denied political clearance by the Ministry of External Affairs, which found the proposed activities unsuitable. However, he has secured clearance for his trip to the UK. As a result, the Chief Minister's office confirmed the cancellation of the US portion, prompting an earlier return to Hyderabad than originally planned.

title: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal gives an update on Temple device
content: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal revealed the Temple wearable device is now smaller and more powerful.  Pre-orders for the limited launch edition will begin very soon.  The device is expected to ship before the end of 2026.  PV Sindhu was recently seen wearing the Temple device at a championship.  This device tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain.

title: Floating Louisiana house built for duck season hits market for $5.5m
content: A unique luxury lodge named Fowl Play is available for $5.5 million in Louisiana. This property is built on floating barges and can be towed into the marsh. It offers waterfront living and outdoor adventure for up to twenty-two people. The lodge provides a commercial-grade kitchen and upscale amenities for guests. This mobile retreat combines hunting and fishing experiences from a single base.

title: Class 10 score 54%, maths 41; three years later he cracked JEE Advanced
content: After struggling with low scores in his Class 10 board exams, Jainendrajeet faced an uphill battle academically. He revamped his study techniques, honing his focus on smart time management and precise learning strategies. His hard work paid off when he achieved an impressive 99.98 percentile in JEE Main and secured AIR 349 in JEE Advanced, earning him a coveted spot in the Computer Science program at IIT Bombay.

title: Apple 'fires' entire VR team as John Ternus takes over as CEO from Tim Cook
content: Apple has laid off at least 60 employees tied to its VR development team, with an entire group working on virtual reality reportedly cut just days before John Ternus takes over as CEO on September 1. The move comes as Apple shifts resources toward Siri AI and smart glasses, leaving Apple Vision Pro, the $3,699 headset Tim Cook once called "tomorrow's technology today," with a visibly shrinking team behind it.

title: Harry and Meghan's California mansion may be sold as couple weighs return to Britain
content: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are contemplating selling their lavish Montecito mansion as the financial burden of over $600,000 annually in mortgage and property taxes weighs heavily. Initially purchased for $14.65 million, the estate is generating buzz among brokers, with potential sale prices estimated between $55 million and $65 million. A final decision may follow their relocation to the UK.

title: Why short-range ballistic missiles are the new weapon of choice, and how Pralay stands out
content: Modern conflicts highlight the challenge of intercepting short-range ballistic missiles effectively.  Russia and Iran have extensively used such weapons in recent warfare.  India's Pralay missile offers battlefield flexibility and operates outside nuclear doctrine.  This missile features terminal maneuverability and a solid-fuel propulsion system.  Pralay's capabilities position it as a leading short-range ballistic missile globally.

title: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry reveal the secret behind their charity work
content: Stephen Curry and his wife, Ayesha Curry, have worked towards their charity together and now the two have opened up about dividing their work.

title: Brittany Mahomes' $15 million business empire beyond Patrick Mahomes
content: Brittany Mahomes has built a career that extends well beyond her connection to Patrick Mahomes. After retiring from professional soccer in 2017, she became a certified fitness trainer and launched Brittany Lynne Fitness. She later joined the ownership group of the Kansas City Current, while expanding her profile through social media and brand partnerships. Her journey reflects how she turned athletic experience into opportunities across fitness, entrepreneurship and women's sports.

title: BJP claims influencers were offered Rs 25,000 to attend Rahul Gandhi's Pune event
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has raised allegations against Rahul Gandhi’s forthcoming event in Pune, claiming it relies on paid influencers. Reports suggest these influencers are being compensated with twenty-five thousand rupees to promote and attend the event. A video shared by the party allegedly illustrates this process, suggesting attendees are tasked with creating and posting promotional content, which casts doubt on the genuine nature of support for the Congress leader.

title: BrahMos after Op Sindoor: Why more countries are lining up for India’s supersonic missile
content: India's Brahmos missile proved its combat effectiveness in recent operations.  This success has significantly boosted its appeal as a defense export.  Several nations are now seeking to acquire this advanced supersonic cruise missile.  The Philippines, Vietnam, and Indonesia have already signed deals for the weapon.  Further interest from countries in the Gulf and Southeast Asia is growing.

title: Quote of the day by Johnny Depp
content: During his appearance at Cannes, Johnny Depp delved into the topic of social conformity versus individuality. He shared a poignant quote relating to the challenge many individuals encounter in being authentic. Recognizing that conformity might be a valid path for some, Depp revealed his inclination to transcend conventional norms, highlighting how his past experiences influenced this perspective.

title: Pakistan's Ali Usman creates history, ends 16-year wait in England
content: Usman was Pakistan's standout bowler. He finished with 5/95 from 24 overs and claimed his first five-wicket haul in England. The left-arm spinner also became the first visiting left-arm spinner since Shakib Al Hasan in 2010 to take five wickets in a Test innings in England. Usman was also the first visiting spinner to take a five-wicket haul at Leeds since Australia's Ashley Mallett took 5/114 in 1972.

title: H1N1 surge sets alarm bells ringing in Delhi, JP Nadda calls key health meet
content: On Friday, Union Health Minister JP Nadda will conduct a crucial review of the H1N1 situation in Delhi. This meeting is prompted by a notable rise in swine flu cases due to unstable weather conditions. Health officials will evaluate healthcare preparedness and devise containment strategies. The primary objective is to enhance surveillance and ensure hospitals are fully equipped to curb the virus's spread in the city.

title: 'Definitely in scheme of things': India refuse to panic over Kuldeep after poor Galle Test
content: Kuldeep picked up just one wicket in 25 overs across both innings in Galle, while Ravindra Jadeja and Manav Suthar shared 14 wickets between them.

title: Sahil Lochab, Delhi teen whose pellet injury sparked Rahul Gandhi-Delhi Police standoff
content: Rahul Gandhi took a stand by protesting for the filing of an FIR concerning the pellet injuries sustained by Sahil Lochab. The injuries were inflicted during a CJP demonstration held on July 20th. After his complaint went unacknowledged, Sahil called for police intervention. His career aspirations have been severely affected due to the multiple pellet injuries he sustained.

title: 'Killed his own mother': YouTuber's startling claim in Lucknow double-murder suicide
content: A journalist alleged her sister's husband brutally beat their ailing mother to death.  The husband then allegedly shot his estranged wife dead outside her workplace.  He subsequently returned home and killed his own sister before taking his life.  The journalist detailed years of alleged abuse her sister endured before the shooting.  Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the tragic events and the firearms used.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's latest estate: Meta owner buys $35 m Irish castle for family getaways
content: In a fascinating development, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired the majestic Strancally Castle in County Waterford. This stunning Gothic-style fortress, constructed circa 1830, has been beautifully renovated by its former proprietors. Their intention for the castle is to have a serene retreat during their visits to Ireland, further expanding Zuckerberg's extensive global real estate portfolio.

content: Leader of opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin asked whether the CM and his govt had shifted from the anti-delimitation resolution passed by the House.

title: Kareena Kapoor's team responds after video sparked 3rd child speculations
content: Kareena Kapoor Khan is not pregnant, despite viral videos sparking speculation about a third child with Saif Ali Khan. Hindustan Times confirmed the rumors are false. The couple, parents to Taimur and Jeh, recently returned from a beach holiday celebrating Saif's 56th birthday. Meanwhile, Saif will reunite with Akshay Kumar in "Haiwaan."

title: Nadda says Rahul's sit-in bid to divert attention from Vande Mataram row
content: Union minister JP Nadda slammed Rahul Gandhi for staging a protest outside a police station, labeling it a desperate bid for media coverage. Nadda asserted that the demonstration was merely an effort to distract from the ongoing Vande Mataram controversy tied to Congress. Meanwhile, Rahul Gandhi sought to address police brutality towards students—an issue the Supreme Court is currently reviewing following the July 20 incident.

title: Salman Khan's gym outlet in Delhi- Greater Kailash-I caught fire
content: A fire broke out at Salman Khan's gym franchise in Delhi's Greater Kailash-I on Thursday night, with police confirming no casualties as staff were evacuated before the fire brigade arrived. A short circuit is suspected. Meanwhile, Salman is shooting "Monster" with Dil Raju and Nayanthara, and will host Bigg Boss 20 from September 6, 2026.

title: 'Hypnotised' Mumbai airhostess handed Rs 200 'dakshina' after rape by 'transgender'

Shinde allegedly sexually assaulted an airhostess after offering to cure her husband. He collected money from residents before fleeing the scene. Police traced the accused through autorickshaw driver and CCTV footage.

title: 'What's going on in the country?' Kejriwal slams BJP over attack on CJP volunteers
content: Arvind Kejriwal has accused BJP supporters of assaulting volunteers from the Cockroach Janata Party during their inspection of a local school. Reports indicate that the volunteers faced violence and had their vehicles damaged by villagers. They expressed frustration over police inaction, demanding that those responsible be arrested within 48 hours.

title: Actor safe after car accident: Arjun Bijlani’s car crashes post promotions
content: Arjun Bijlani faced a car accident while returning from promotional activities, but fortunately, he and his companions emerged unscathed. There were no significant injuries reported, and Bijlani is recovering well. Recently, he participated in the Indian Game Show promoting his forthcoming Netflix venture, leading fans to express their relief and shower him with well wishes after the incident.

title: UP man bitten by 5-ft snake kills it, then walks into hospital carrying it in bag
content: After being bitten by a snake, Uttam Nayak took the unusual step of bringing the dead creature to a hospital. He killed the snake himself and, despite the bite, waited until morning for medical help. Upon evaluation, doctors confirmed there were no traces of venom in his body, indicating that the single bite minimized any severe effects. Nayak is now receiving treatment and is reported to be safe.

title: 'Rushed her to hospital': MP son's 1st reaction on Aston Martin crash that killed woman
content: Lingamaneni Sanjush stated he did not flee the accident scene. He immediately transported the injured woman to Apollo Hospital for treatment. Sanjush also reported to the police station and cooperated with the investigation. Medical tests confirmed he had not consumed alcohol or drugs. The police are continuing their investigation into the fatal road accident.

title: SBI cash withdrawal rules change from October 1: Rs 15 fee after four free transactions
content: SBI customers will face charges for cash withdrawals exceeding four free monthly transactions.  A fee of Rs 15 plus GST applies to Basic Savings Bank Deposit accounts.  Digital transactions remain free, and Aadhaar Enabled Payment System transactions are now counted.  Interest rates on bulk term deposits were revised earlier this month.  SBI reported a profit increase for the first quarter of FY27.

title: ‘Live-in relationship akin to marriage, parents can’t interfere’: Delhi HC
content: The Delhi High Court has affirmed the status of live-in relationships, treating them similarly to marriage. It emphasized that consenting adults have the freedom to choose their partners free from external influence. The court also ensured police protection for a couple threatened by family members, affirming that societal biases cannot infringe upon the fundamental constitutional rights of individuals. This decision bolsters the legal legitimacy of such unions.

title: Imran Khan's kin say Pak govt violated court order for not taking ex-PM to private hospital
content: Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan returned to Adiala Jail after a medical examination.  Khan was taken for a check-up amid concerns about his health and treatment.  His family alleged solitary confinement, which they described as mental torture.  Authorities cited security concerns for changing his hospital destination.  Khan has been in custody since August 2023 on corruption charges.

title: India’s office market set for sustained growth as 77% of firms plan to expand: Report
content: India's office market is set for expansion over the next two years.  Companies anticipate growth and seek high-quality, well-connected workplaces.  Global Capability Centres and business expansion will support this office demand.  Artificial intelligence is increasingly influencing future leasing decisions and strategies.  Flexible workspaces and commute connectivity will shape office location choices.

title: ‘Politics of anarchy’: BJP attacks Rahul Gandhi over police station protest
content: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi for protesting outside a police station.  He sought an FIR regarding alleged pellet gun injuries suffered by a student.  The BJP stated an FIR was already registered and a committee was investigating.  Rahul Gandhi accused the Home Minister of being scared of justice.  The Congress leader continued his protest until an FIR was filed.

title: 'Everyone has diabetes': Bihar minister says sugar price rise won’t matter much

Opposition party RJD criticized the minister's insensitive remarks about common people. They also blamed central government policies for the sugar price increase. Meanwhile, retail sugar and onion prices are also seeing significant rises.

title: Treesa-Gayatri end India’s 15-year wait, assure Badminton World Championships medal
content: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships medal.  They achieved this after a comeback victory in the women's doubles quarterfinals.  This guarantees the unseeded Indian pair at least a bronze medal.  Their achievement marks the country's first medal in this event since 2011.  The pair has shown strong progress and resilience throughout their career.
